setup.scanDescription: Kun opens the official page. Scan there or use this QR code; credentials are encrypted and stay on this device.
setup.feishuReturnHint: When Feishu shows “Created successfully”, return to Kun. You do not need to click “Open app”; Kun opens account authorization automatically.

setup.authorized: App registration completed. Continue account authorization.
setup.mailIntro: Use a client authorization code, never your mailbox password. Kun tests both receiving and sending before saving.
setup.wecomIntro: Create a smart bot in the official WeCom admin console, then enter its Bot ID and Secret. Webhook mode exposes send-only actions.
setup.oauthClientSecretUpdate: OAuth client secret (enter again to update)
setup.reuseOAuth: Reuse this OAuth app configuration for {{preset}} services. Account tokens remain isolated per service.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.description: Accounts are named explicitly; actions never silently fall back to another account.

policy.title: Action policy
policy.description: Rules use exact Action IDs, service.*, or *. Kun still requests approval for write, send, delete, and unknown actions.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.description: OpenConnector returns redacted summaries; bootstrap and provider secrets never enter this view.

oauth.denied: Authorization was denied by the provider.
oauth.failed: Authorization failed. Review the advanced configuration and try again.

errors.generic: The connector request failed. Try again or open technical details.
errors.unavailable: The local connector service is unavailable.
errors.unsafe_verification_url: The provider returned a non-official verification address and Kun blocked it.
errors.device_registration_not_supported: This app does not support scan registration in the installed runtime.
errors.device_registration_not_found: The scan session expired. Scan again; an app already created at the provider is not connected to Kun.
errors.feishu_redirect_permission_missing: This Feishu app lacks permission to register the callback. Scan again with the updated Kun build, then return to Kun when Feishu says the app was created.
errors.feishu_redirect_config_failed: Kun could not register its local callback with Feishu. Scan again, or use advanced manual setup.
